name: Distinct member / distinct issuer

request.need: ADR-001 needs an S6: the voucher is not the holder; multi-issuer needs k distinct accredited issuers

statement: A verifier learns that two credentials in one proof come from two distinct members (or issuers), with the duplicate case unsatisfiable rather than merely rejected.
witness: two credential leaves/secrets and their paths
publicInputs: the two nullifiers or issuer ids as constrained public signals

relation.clause: leaf_a ≠ leaf_b (or issuer_a ≠ issuer_b) enforced as a non-zero inverse constraint — no witness exists for equality

disclosureSet: that the two are distinct — nothing about which two
doesNotEstablish: that the two parties are independent in the accreditation sense (declared, not proven — X8)
distinct natural persons or independent key controllers merely from distinct leaves, keys or issuer identifiers

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board

formal.system: Lean 4.33.1, core library only (no Mathlib); axiom footprint within propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound — no sorry, no added axiom
formal.location: formal/Formal/Gadgets/P005Distinct.lean in the evidence repository (uncommitted at this revision)
formal.reproduce: sh formal/scripts/check-axioms.sh — builds, prints each theorem's axiom footprint, fails on sorry or a non-standard axiom
formal.statement: the inverse constraint (a − b) · inv = 1 over the circuit field Fin n; and Formal.Gadgets.owners_distinct, the k-ary form composed records use

theorems.name: inverse_unsat_on_equal
theorems.proves: the duplicate case has no witness: (a − b) · inv ≠ 1 when a = b

theorems.name: FinOps
theorems.proves: the three field facts the gadget needs hold for Fin n, n > 1 — so for the BN254 scalar field outright

theorems.name: owners_distinct
theorems.proves: pairwise-distinct values, each owned under a one-value-per-owner rule, come from as many pairwise-distinct owners (record 024's soundness is an instance)

theorems.name: distinct_leaves_not_distinct_persons
theorems.proves: does-not-establish 3: distinct leaves held by one person

hypotheses.name: one value per owner
hypotheses.carries: the issuer's enrolment gives each member one leaf — carries owners_distinct

hypotheses.name: inverse exists when a ≠ b
hypotheses.carries: completeness of the constraint needs n prime; not proved here (circuit gate)

formal.scope: unsatisfiability of the duplicate case, proved without cryptographic assumption; independence and honesty (does-not-establish 1, 2) are declarations outside any clause

revisions.note: formal model built (Lean, gadget library): the clause as a definition, its soundness, the counter-deployments that show which hypotheses are necessary, and the negative space classified; no state change
